name: finetune_indian

metrics.harness: scripts/eval_inria.py on 5 Inria val tiles for the regression check; webapp/calibration.py reference calibration against 141 OpenStreetMap footprints in CV Raman Nagar, Bangalore, for the recall figures

inria_5tile.note: Lower than the shipped model BY CONSTRUCTION: an envelope prediction over-covers Inria's footprint labels, which costs precision while recall holds. Not catastrophic forgetting.

limitations: Predicts building-cluster envelopes, not individual footprints — building COUNT is meaningless and area includes inter-building alleys.
Trained on 80 tiles from two Indian cities; unvalidated anywhere else.
Regresses precision on Western imagery (Inria 5-tile IoU 0.80 -> 0.65).
